project_info.name: Distro Logistics
project_info.description: High-contrast B2B Distribution & Logistics Web Application designed for Suppliers, Retailers, and Platform Admins.
project_info.theme_support: Dual Mode (Dark / Light toggle with High-Contrast aesthetic)

design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: High-density tactical control center meets clean Swiss typography and smooth micro-interactions.

Tactical High Contrast: Sharp boundaries, 1px solid structural borders, vivid functional accents (Emerald for delivered, Amber for processing, Electric Indigo for primary action, Coral Red for alerts).
B2B Frictionless Efficiency: Tiered bulk pricing visualization, minimum order quantity (MOQ) controls, quick order batching, and real-time order tracking status.
Role-Aware Spatial Design: Seamless view switches between Retailer Store Owner, Supplier/Distributor, and System Admin with persistent role indicator badges.

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

header.style: Fixed top nav with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md), border-b, search bar, role dropdown, notification bell indicator, cart drawer trigger, dark/light theme toggle switch.

dashboard_grid.metrics_row: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 mb-8
dashboard_grid.catalog_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

retailer.name: Retailer / Store Owner
core_actions: Browse B2B Catalog with category filters (Beverages, Groceries, Snacks, Bulk Pantry)
View B2B Wholesale Tier Pricing & MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity)
Batch add items to B2B Bulk Cart with quantity steppers (+10, +50, +100 units)
Checkout flow: Select Delivery Warehouse Address + Add Special Order Notes & Delivery Time Window
Order History with live interactive timeline (Pending -> Processing -> In Transit -> Delivered)
Direct Messaging drawer with assigned Supplier

supplier.name: Supplier / Distributor
core_actions: Inventory & Product Manager (Add new B2B product, adjust stock, set tier prices & MOQ)
Order Management Panel (Accept / Reject incoming bulk orders, update delivery status to In Transit/Delivered)
Revenue & Volume Analytics cards with Interactive Sales Charts (Recharts / Shadcn charts)
Supplier Stock Alert Badges (Low stock alerts, rapid re-order recommendations)

admin.name: Platform Admin
core_actions: Supplier Approval Queue (Approve new distributor verification requests)
User Management table (Filter by Retailer / Supplier / Admin, toggle active state)
Global Logistics Overview (Total GMV, aggregate order fulfillment rate, platform fee revenue)

sample_products.name: Wholesale Chocolate Bars Variety Box (48 Count)
Premium Potato Chips Bulk Display Box (36 Units)

interactive_components_rules.toast_notifications: Use Sonner from `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx` or equivalent for order placements, status updates, and stock alerts.
interactive_components_rules.modals_and_drawers: Use customized Shadcn Dialog and Sheet components with explicit background fill (never transparent background).
interactive_components_rules.data_test_ids: CRITICAL: Every interactive button, input, card, badge, tab, role toggle, and dropdown MUST have a unique data-testid (e.g., data-testid='role-switcher-supplier', data-testid='bulk-cart-checkout-btn', data-testid='order-status-badge-PROD-101').
interactive_components_rules.motion_and_hover: Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white). Use micro-transitions like duration-200 ease-in-out.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this guidelines JSON carefully before implementing components.
2. Ensure the App supports instantaneous role switching (Retailer, Supplier, Admin) via persistent Header Controls or Quick Demo Switcher.
3. Build the B2B catalog with real-time tier pricing updates as quantity changes in the bulk order modal or cart.
4. Include interactive In-App Messaging between Retailer and Supplier with mock messages & quick reply buttons.
5. Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) for clear B2B logistics visual cues (Truck, Package, ShieldCheck, TrendingUp, Filter, MessageSquare, Bell, Moon, Sun, Plus, Minus, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle).
6. Include responsive layout for both Desktop views and Mobile drawers/bottom sheets.
7. Always attach data-testid to every interactive component for automated test validation.
